stem: What was one DIRECT effect of the business practice discussed in this excerpt?
instruction: Read the excerpt and answer the question that follows.

options.label: A
options.text: Employees were prevented from buying stock.

options.label: B
options.text: There was decreased competition among producers.

options.label: C

options.label: D
